Garage description
According to rumors, this cover was developed for space landing divisions, intended for lightning-fast missions to save Mars from alien invaders. The paint was eventually sold to raise funds for a mission that would send a tank division to Mars.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on January 30, 2015.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Mars was worth 143,500 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Major General.
Legacy paint description:
This paint provides decent protection from Hammer, Isida and Firebird. Excellent choice for close combat. With it equipped, your tank armor looks like the surface of a distant planet.
